summary: Tested International Bank Support feature for withdrawals. Fixed a backend bug where international account withdrawals (without IBAN) caused 500 error. All 10 backend tests pass, all frontend features verified working.

fixed.issue: TypeError when creating withdrawal with international account (no IBAN) - code tried to slice None value
fixed.fix: Added null check for iban before slicing, fallback to account_number[-4:] for international accounts

passed_tests: ✅ Backend: Admin login successful
✅ Backend: GET /api/accounts returns user accounts
✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with IBAN (European) withdrawal - Spain
✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with International Account - Mexico (BBVA México)
✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with International Account - Colombia (Bancolombia)
✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with International Account - USA (Chase with routing number)
✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with manual bank entry (Banco del Austro - Ecuador)
✅ Backend: BankingInfo model accepts minimal required fields only
✅ Backend: GET /api/transactions returns banking_info for withdrawals
✅ Backend: Withdrawal without banking_info correctly rejected (400/422)
✅ Frontend: Withdraw page (/withdraw) loads correctly
✅ Frontend: IBAN mode selected by default
✅ Frontend: Switching between IBAN and International Account modes works
✅ Frontend: International Account mode shows: Country selector, Account Number, SWIFT/BIC, Routing fields
✅ Frontend: Selecting Mexico shows Mexican banks (BBVA México, Banorte, Citibanamex, etc.)
✅ Frontend: Selecting Colombia shows Colombian banks (Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA Colombia, Nequi, etc.)
✅ Frontend: Selecting USA shows US banks (Bank of America, Chase, Wells Fargo, Citibank, Capital One)
✅ Frontend: USA mode shows 'Routing Number' label instead of 'Codigo de Ruta'
✅ Frontend: 'Mi banco no aparece' link shows manual bank entry form
✅ Frontend: Manual bank entry form has bank name, country, and city fields
✅ Frontend: IBAN validation works - auto-detects country and bank from IBAN
✅ Frontend: Valid Spanish IBAN shows 'Informacion detectada automaticamente' with España and CaixaBank
seed_data_creation: Created test withdrawal transactions for Spain, Mexico, Colombia, USA, Ecuador during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: International bank support feature fully tested and working. Two modes available: IBAN (Europe) and International Account (worldwide). Backend BankingInfo model accepts optional iban, account_number, swift_code, routing_number fields. Banks available for: ES, MX, CO, AR, CL, PE, EC, US, BR, GB, DE, FR, IT, PT. Manual bank entry available via 'Mi banco no aparece' link. IBAN validation uses MOD 97 algorithm and auto-detects country/bank from Spanish IBANs.

withdraw_page_modes.iban_mode: Default mode for European countries with IBAN validation
withdraw_page_modes.international_mode: For worldwide countries with account_number, swift_code, routing_number

features_verified.manual_bank_entry: Available via 'Mi banco no aparece' link with bank name, country, city fields
features_verified.iban_validation: MOD 97 algorithm, auto-detects country and bank from IBAN

bug_fixed.description: International account withdrawals (without IBAN) caused 500 Internal Server Error
bug_fixed.root_cause: Line 2105 in server.py tried to slice tx_data.banking_info.iban[-4:] without checking if iban was None
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added null check: iban[-4:] if iban else account_number[-4:] if account_number else 'N/A'
